definition:
Dokument (subtitled Izštekani session 17.12.2004.) is the first live album by the Croatian alternative rock band Pips, Chips & Videoclips, released by Menart in December 2005. It documents a studio unplugged performance recorded for Izštekani—a long-running acoustic radio series on Slovenia’s Radio Val 202—and presents stripped-down reinterpretations of songs spanning multiple phases of the band’s catalogue.
